description: Per ADR 019eebb3-f8db. At RSVP submit, mint a guest_id for a named +1 and stamp it on the +1's rsvps row; append the +1 to official-guest-list (host party_id, host side, plus_one_allowed FALSE, new source column ="plus-one"; blank=invitation for existing rows). Idempotent on (party_id + normalized name) — a +1 named twice must reuse its id, not duplicate. is_plus_one now = source=="plus-one", not empty guest_id.
title: Named plus-ones become first-class Guests (RSVP write-back)
acceptance_criteria: A named +1 gets a real guest_id stamped on its rsvps row
The +1 appears in official-guest-list with host party_id, host side, plus_one_allowed FALSE, source=plus-one
Re-submitting the same +1 (party_id + normalized name) does not duplicate the Guest List row or id
The reader parses source with blank default; existing 65 rows unaffected
Unit tests cover mint, idempotency, write-back, and reader
Deployed and couple-confirmed a named +1 shows as a Guest
